titleText: Other news you might find interesting
mainText: Young people should have legal guarantee of job or training, Milburn tells BBC. Milburn is not the first to try and fix the Neets problem - so what’s different this time round, asks Laura Kuenssberg. US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says. The Ukrainian president says US envoys touted the exchange as part of efforts to end the war with Russia. Watch: Cruise ship overturns after collision with tanker in New Orleans.
